paragraphs: Hapco designs, engineers, and manufactures light poles and the hardware that hangs on them, selling to the lighting professionals who specify poles for a project. Its poles show up in street, area, roadway, utility, municipal, and pedestrian lighting work.

The catalog runs from anchor base and direct buried poles to decorative, hinged, solar, camera, and small cell 5G antenna poles. Alongside the poles it sells banner arms in standard and breakaway designs for single and double sided applications. A modular decorative arm system lets a specifier mix interchangeable components into different configurations for a streetscape.

Manufacturing happens in Abingdon, Virginia. The company says its products meet the criteria of the Build America Buy America Act, which matters on publicly funded work. It holds ISO9001:2015 and AISC certifications, and its news page announces Tom Hardy as President and CEO.

quote.text: American Materials. American Manufacturing. American Quality.
